front/idle: Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation sprite sheet for exact reference I2 character. FRONT view, idle. Reference 1 canonical front; reference 2 opposite construction. Preserve EXACT design, all equipment and materials, silhouette and rendering. Golden plump seagull made of bright molten gold, tan angular cracked-stone crown, molten-gold-edged stone outer wings plus golden feather wings, large icy blue faceted crystal embedded in golden stone breast bezel on FRONT ONLY, gold drips, and the TWO tall brown stone casting-mold gate slabs behind the bird. Gate slabs are integral character attachments: retain exact paired shape, bolts, proportions and orientations in every frame. Back shows golden tail and rear feathers, never chest crystal. Maintain canonical front three-quarter camera throughout; never turn to opposite view. SIX SMALL FULL-BODY SPRITES arranged on an EXPANSIVE TRANSPARENT CANVAS in 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows. 1536x1024, six 512x512 cells, row-major order. Characters and their ENTIRE attachments/effects should occupy ONLY 65% of each cell width/height, max 340x340px, generous 85px clear side margins. Wide empty gutters between ALL figures. All complete alpha must fit local x85..427,y90..442. Fixed camera, constant scale and foot pivot at (256,442) in each cell. Poses: 1 neutral, 2 shallow inhale, 3 breath crest, 4 exhale, 5 settling, 6 near neutral for seamless loop. Very restrained secondary movement. Transparent RGBA background, no floor or cast ground shadow. No text, labels, grid, scenery, extra figures, crop, overlap, enormous VFX or redesigned parts.
